app.name: Voltique Home
app.tagline: Track what your home makes, stores and uses.

errors.title: That did not work
errors.offline: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.timeout: The server took too long to respond.

auth.devShortcutNote: Development shortcut. The mock always signs you in as a consumer, so this is the only way into the installer shell until the backend can vary the role.

household.title: Households
household.name: Name
household.timezoneHint: Daily and monthly totals are bucketed in this zone.
household.emptyDescription: Create a household first. Assets, alerts and installer access all hang off it.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.noData: No readings for this period yet.

assets.title: Assets
assets.emptyDescription: Add a charger, inverter, battery or heat pump to start tracking this household.
assets.removeExplanation: Its history stays on the server, but it stops appearing in this household and no new readings are collected.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.emptyDescription: No faults have been raised for this household.

access.title: Who can see this
access.removeExplanation: They lose access immediately. Anything they added stays in the household.
access.residentNote: A resident sees everything in this household and can add assets.
access.installerNote: An installer sees your assets, their logs and their faults. Not your household settings.

invite.title: Invitation
invite.failed: This invitation is no longer valid.

installer.emptyDescription: Households appear here once someone invites you to theirs.

logs.title: Device logs
logs.empty: This asset has not reported anything yet.

notifications.promptDescription: Get a notification when an asset stops working, so you are not relying on opening the app.
notifications.deniedDescription: Turn them on for Voltique Home in your device settings if you change your mind.
notifications.unavailable: Push notifications need a real device, not a simulator.
notifications.notRegistered: This device is not registered yet.

network.writeBlocked: You are offline. This change needs a connection.

recent.title: Recently opened
recent.settingsExplanation: Keeps the last few assets and households you opened, so they are one tap away. Stored on this phone only, never sent anywhere, and deleted when you turn this off or sign out.

addAsset.title: Add asset
addAsset.noManufacturers: No manufacturers listed for this yet.
addAsset.nameHint: What you want to call it in this household.
addAsset.credentialsNote: These are sent to the manufacturer integration and are never shown again.
addAsset.needHouseholdDescription: Assets belong to a household, so one has to exist before you can add to it.

placeholder.dashboardDescription: Household production, consumption and battery state over time, with the charts fed by the telemetry endpoints.
placeholder.alertsDescription: Open faults across the household, acknowledged and resolved from here.
placeholder.installerHouseholdsDescription: Households that invited you, with the assets and device logs you are scoped to see.
placeholder.installerAlertsDescription: Faults across every household you maintain, with the raw device logs behind each one.
